entities.summary: Dzheyrakh-Assa Museum-Reserve is a Ingush cultural and historical landscape in Ingushetia, consisting of a number of reserves and auls. In the territory of 64 thousand hectares there are about five hundred stone architectural complexes: Ingush towers and funerary crypts, Pagan and Christian shrines and temples. The first towers date back to the II millennium BC.
